summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature across rich/progress.py, tests/test_progress.py, docs/source/progress.rst, and CHANGELOG.md. Nothing was committed. Tests, black, mypy, and a Python 3.6.2 import check were NOT run, per instructions, so all of it is unverified. Key choices: module-level open casts mode to the three typed literals; Progress.open is overloaded for r/rt (TextIO) and rb (BinaryIO); the implementation return type is ContextManager[Any]; suppressions limited to readline (override), readinto (no-untyped-def, override), and the handle's readinto call (attr-defined); write raises io.UnsupportedOperation("write"); the reader defines mode and name properties for Python 3.6 abstract-method enforcement. Open risks to check: TextIOWrapper acceptance of the reader under mypy, and RawIOBase plus BinaryIO multiple inheritance on 3.6.
